scope:
Whole new registry module + exact pinned SDK RX/config lifetime spans.

Host layout/crypto/RTOS/capacity inputs and adaptive metadata remain explicit
seams. Canonical reclaim source is whole. No SDK build/QEMU/hardware/real OOM or
TLS conformance claim. Numeric/pointer userdata is never interpreted by module.

commands.label: tools-before
argv: import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess; names=["/usr/bin/gcc","/usr/bin/g++","/usr/bin/as","/usr/bin/ld"]; names += [subprocess.check_output(["/usr/bin/gcc",v],text=True).strip() for v in ["-print-prog-name=cc1","-print-prog-name=cc1plus","-print-prog-name=collect2","-print-file-name=libasan.so","-print-file-name=libubsan.so"]]; print(json.dumps({str(pathlib.Path(p).resolve()):hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in names})); print(subprocess.check_output(["/usr/bin/gcc","--version"],text=True))

argv: import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess; names=["/usr/bin/gcc","/usr/bin/g++","/usr/bin/as","/usr/bin/ld"]; names += [subprocess.check_output(["/usr/bin/gcc",v],text=True).strip() for v in ["-print-prog-name=cc1","-print-prog-name=cc1plus","-print-prog-name=collect2","-print-file-name=libasan.so","-print-file-name=libubsan.so"]]; print(json.dumps({str(pathlib.Path(p).resolve()):hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in names})); print(subprocess.check_output(["/usr/bin/gcc","--version"],text=True))
